name: Slotte i Danmark (Palaces and Castles of Denmark)
title: Slotte i Danmark (Palaces and Castles of Denmark)
description: Catalog of palaces, castles, and castle ruins in Denmark — including royal residences (Amalienborg, Christiansborg, Rosenborg, Kronborg, Frederiksborg), historic manor-castles, and medieval castle ruins. Sourced from Danish Wikipedia category 'Slotte i Danmark' (and subcategories Fredede slotte og herregårde i Danmark, Residensslotte i Danmark, plus pages under Christiansborg Slot / Kronborg / Rosenborg Slot subcats) and enriched with Wikidata properties (P31 instance-of, P17 country, P131 administrative location, P149 architectural style, P84 architect, P1435 heritage designation, P571 inception year, P18 image, P625 coordinates).
